tagline.zh: writing-mode 重定义整盒子的流方向:vertical-rl 一句让中文回到传统竖排(行从右往左),text-orientation 管竖排里每个字形的朝向,text-combine-upright 把年份数字叠成一小格——书脊、诗笺与竖排表单的底座。
tagline.en: writing-mode redefines the flow of a whole box: one vertical-rl line returns Chinese to traditional vertical setting (lines running right-to-left); text-orientation governs each glyph's direction inside; text-combine-upright stacks year digits into one cell — the base of spines, poem cards and vertical forms.

origin.zh: 出自 CSS Writing Modes(css-writing-modes 规范,调研 12§2):取值 horizontal-tb(默认)/ vertical-rl(传统中日竖排)/ vertical-lr / sideways-rl / sideways-lr(字形整体侧放,仍为 experimental,需 @supports 检测);lr/tb 等旧值已废弃。配套属性:direction(行内方向)、text-orientation(竖排字形朝向)、text-combine-upright(纵横对齐)。writing-mode Baseline 自 2017-03;sideways-* 需特性检测(调研 12§2)。
origin.en: From CSS Writing Modes (research 12 §2): values horizontal-tb (default) / vertical-rl (traditional CJK vertical) / vertical-lr / sideways-rl / sideways-lr (glyphs rotated whole, still experimental, needs @supports detection); the legacy lr/tb values are deprecated. Companions: direction (inline direction), text-orientation (glyph orientation in vertical lines), text-combine-upright (tate-chu-yoko digit stacking). writing-mode is Baseline since 2017-03; sideways-* requires feature detection (research 12 §2).

effect.zh: 信纸的书写模式(CSS 型 --wm-mode)。默认 vertical-rl——调研 12§2 记为「传统中日竖排」且 12§2 片段给出 aside h2 { writing-mode: vertical-rl } 书脊标签配方;horizontal-tb 为规范默认值;sideways-lr 为 experimental,引擎不支持时值无效回落 horizontal-tb,demo 用 @supports 思路的运行时检测(CSS.supports)如实报告。
effect.en: The letter sheet's writing mode (CSS-type --wm-mode). The vertical-rl default is research 12 §2's 'traditional CJK vertical', whose fragment also gives the aside h2 { writing-mode: vertical-rl } spine-label recipe; horizontal-tb is the spec default; sideways-lr is experimental — engines without it drop the value back to horizontal-tb, and the demo reports this honestly via runtime detection (CSS.supports, the @supports idea).

label.zh: mixed 汉字直立·西文旋转

effect.zh: 竖排里的字形朝向 text-orientation(CSS 型 --wm-orientation;调研 12§2 配套属性)。mixed 为规范默认:汉字保持直立、西文旋转 90°;upright 让拉丁字母也一个个直立堆叠;sideways 全部侧放——demo 标题里的「Li Bai」是观察三档差异的探针,仅竖排档生效。
effect.en: Glyph orientation inside vertical lines via text-orientation (CSS-type --wm-orientation; a research 12 §2 companion property). mixed is the spec default: CJK stays upright, latin rotates 90°; upright stacks latin letters one by one, upright; sideways rotates everything — the demo title's 'Li Bai' is the probe for the three grades, effective only in vertical modes.

effect.zh: 年份「2026」的 text-combine-upright(CSS 型 --wm-combine;调研 12§2 记为「纵横对齐」)。all 档把竖排行内连续数字压缩进一个字格横排显示——日文「縦中横」惯例,中文竖排年份同样适用;仅对行内短数字串有意义。
effect.en: The year '2026' under text-combine-upright (CSS-type --wm-combine; research 12 §2's 'tate-chu-yoko / 纵横对齐'). all compresses a run of digits in a vertical line into one em-square shown horizontally — the Japanese tate-chu-yoko convention, equally apt for years in vertical Chinese; only meaningful for short inline digit runs.

note.zh: writing-mode Baseline 自 2017-03(调研 12§2);horizontal-tb / vertical-rl / vertical-lr 与配套 text-orientation、text-combine-upright 各主流引擎长期可用。sideways-rl / sideways-lr 仍为 experimental——调研 12§2 明确要求 @supports 检测,各家正式支持版本未核验(未证实),demo 以 CSS.supports 运行时检测如实报告当前路径。
note.en: writing-mode is Baseline since 2017-03 (research 12 §2); horizontal-tb / vertical-rl / vertical-lr and the companions text-orientation, text-combine-upright have long been available across mainstream engines. sideways-rl / sideways-lr remain experimental — research 12 §2 explicitly requires @supports detection, and per-browser release versions are unverified (unverified); the demo reports the live path via CSS.supports runtime detection.

fallback.zh: 渐进增强两级:①sideways-lr 不支持时值无效回落 horizontal-tb,故实验值永远配 @supports 检测——调研 12§2 片段的回退写法是 transform: rotate(-90deg) 侧放西文,demo 用同一思路的运行时检测并切换回退类;②竖排整体不支持的环境(极老引擎)保持横排可读,内容顺序仍按 DOM——竖排是呈现增强,不是内容依赖。
fallback.en: Two progressive tiers: ① an unsupported sideways-lr value falls back to horizontal-tb, so the experimental value always ships with @supports detection — research 12 §2's fallback form is transform: rotate(-90deg) for latin, and the demo applies the same idea via runtime detection and a fallback class; ② engines without vertical writing keep horizontal, readable, DOM-ordered content — vertical setting is presentational enhancement, never a content dependency.

use.zh: 中文竖排诗笺/书法页面:vertical-rl 恢复「自上而下、行从右起」的传统文序
use.en: Vertical Chinese poem or calligraphy pages: vertical-rl restores the traditional top-to-bottom, right-to-left line order

use.zh: 侧边书脊标签:aside h2 { writing-mode: vertical-rl }——调研 12§2 片段的原始用例
use.en: Side spine labels: aside h2 { writing-mode: vertical-rl } — research 12 §2's original fragment use case

use.zh: 竖排里的年份与编号:text-combine-upright: all 让「2026」占一个字格,不打断行气
use.en: Years and numbers inside vertical lines: text-combine-upright: all fits '2026' in one em-square without breaking the line rhythm

use.zh: 日式纵排表单/名片类版式:vertical-rl + text-orientation 控制混排字形朝向
use.en: Japanese vertical forms and card layouts: vertical-rl + text-orientation tuning mixed-script glyph orientation

avoid.zh: 整站正文竖排——竖行阅读效率低于横排,竖排适合短文本与装饰性版块
avoid.en: Setting whole-site body copy vertical — vertical lines read slower; vertical suits short text and decorative blocks

avoid.zh: 生产环境裸写 sideways-lr 不加检测——experimental 值在未支持引擎整条无效(调研 12§2)
avoid.en: Shipping bare sideways-lr without detection in production — the experimental value is wholly invalid on unsupporting engines (research 12 §2)

avoid.zh: 用 lr/tb 旧值——已废弃(调研 12§2)
avoid.en: Using the legacy lr/tb values — deprecated (research 12 §2)

avoid.zh: 竖排里塞长英文单词——词内断行不可控,拉丁长词应放横排容器或 sideways 独立块
avoid.en: Long English words inside vertical CJK lines — intra-word breaking is uncontrolled; keep long latin in horizontal containers or dedicated sideways blocks

a11y.zh: writing-mode 只改视觉流,不改 DOM 顺序——读屏按 DOM 朗读,竖排诗的行序在无障碍树里保持书写者语义(WCAG 1.3.2);竖排容器中的方向性图标与下划线需核对镜像;sideways-lr 的 transform 回退不改变文本语义,读屏读到的仍是原文;对比度在竖排长笔画字形下仍按 WCAG 1.4.3 核对;装饰性书脊标签 aria-hidden。
a11y.en: writing-mode changes the visual flow, never DOM order — screen readers read the DOM, so a vertical poem keeps the author's line semantics in the accessibility tree (WCAG 1.3.2); re-check directional icons and underlines for mirroring inside vertical containers; the transform fallback for sideways-lr preserves text semantics — assistive tech still reads the original string; contrast holds per WCAG 1.4.3 even with long vertical strokes; decorative spine labels get aria-hidden.

goal.zh: 复刻一张竖排诗笺:writing-mode: vertical-rl 让四行五言自上而下、行从右往左,text-orientation: mixed 保持汉字直立、西文旋转,text-combine-upright: all 把年份压进一个字格,旁挂一条 vertical-rl 书脊标签。
goal.en: Replicate a vertical poem card: writing-mode: vertical-rl sets four five-character lines top-to-bottom, lines starting from the right; text-orientation: mixed keeps CJK upright while latin rotates; text-combine-upright: all squeezes the year into one em-square; a vertical-rl spine label hangs alongside.

acceptance.zh: writing-mode 值严格采用参数快照(默认 vertical-rl),不用已废弃的 lr/tb
acceptance.en: The writing-mode value uses the exact parameter snapshot (default vertical-rl); no deprecated lr/tb

acceptance.zh: sideways-* 只与 @supports(或运行时 CSS.supports)检测同框出现,并带 rotate 回退
acceptance.en: sideways-* appears only alongside @supports (or runtime CSS.supports) detection, with a rotate fallback

acceptance.zh: text-orientation 与 text-combine-upright 严格采用参数快照值
acceptance.en: text-orientation and text-combine-upright use the exact parameter snapshot values

acceptance.zh: 竖排只做呈现增强:关闭竖排时内容仍按 DOM 顺序横排可读
acceptance.en: Vertical setting stays presentational: with it off, content remains readable horizontally in DOM order

acceptance.zh: 竖排行内的西文与数字按 mixed/upright/all 语义正确处理,不手插空格伪造间距
acceptance.en: Latin and digits inside vertical lines follow mixed/upright/all semantics — no manual spaces faking spacing
